title: Ramona Air Attack Base Grand Re-Opening
description:
Hundreds of community members from Ramona joined CAL FIRE and County Fire for the grand re-opening of the Ramona Air Attack Base at the Ramona Airport.
CAL FIRE San Diego Unit Chief Tony Mecham highlighted new aircraft that will help protect communities across San Diego County, including a Fire Hawk night-flying helicopter and a C-130 Hercules large airtanker capable of carrying 4,000 gallons of fire retardant. The base also received significant upgrades, including new tanks for mixing retardant and a system that quickly delivers the retardant mixture directly to aircraft on the flight line.
